MOJO AISummits

Privacy Policy

Last updated August 13, 2026.

Information We Collect

When you submit a member or guest registration, MOJO AI Summits collects the information you provide, including your name, company, title, industry, email address, mobile phone number, event role, and publication-use preferences for your name and company. Gmail and other personal email addresses may be used for registration. We may also record phone verification status for account validation and event operations.

How We Use Information

We use registration information to review invitations, validate attendee accounts, coordinate member and guest event logistics, and communicate about MOJO AI Summits. SMS from the registration flow is used to send one-time verification codes requested by the user, reminders about upcoming events the user has registered for, and notifications about additional MOJO AI Summits events no more than once per month.

If you opt in, we may use your name and company in artifacts built for publication. Title and industry are collected for event context, segmentation, and planning.

SMS Verification

If you select Verify Phone, MOJO AI Summits may send a one-time text message to validate the mobile number associated with your registration. We may also use that number for reminders about upcoming events you have registered for and notifications about additional MOJO AI Summits events no more than once per month. Message frequency is one verification text per request plus event reminders and monthly event notices. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help.

Sharing

We do not sell SMS opt-in data or share it with third parties for their marketing. We do not share email addresses with sponsors or any other organizations. We may share information with service providers that help operate registration, hosting, storage, messaging, and event workflows, subject to appropriate confidentiality and security controls.

Website Analytics and Cookies

We may use privacy-first website analytics to understand aggregate site traffic, campaign performance, page usage, and site performance. Our default analytics standard is to use Cloudflare platform analytics or Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is designed for aggregate measurement without advertising retargeting or visitor personal-data collection.

MOJO AI Summits does not use advertising pixels, cross-site retargeting tags, or non-essential analytics cookies unless those tools are separately approved, disclosed here, and supported by any required consent mechanism. Essential cookies or similar technologies may be used for site security, authentication, access control, routing, SMS verification, or to remember privacy choices.

Conversion Measurement

We measure conversion activity such as event page visits, registration starts, invite-code validation, phone verification, registration submissions, partner-interest requests, booking actions, and campaign source performance. Conversion reporting is used for internal operations, event planning, sponsor-fit assessment, and improving the registration experience.

We do not intentionally include email addresses, phone numbers, SMS verification codes, passwords, access tokens, or full invite codes in website analytics events or campaign URL parameters.

Contact

For privacy or SMS support, contact hello@mojoaisummits.com.
